diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified the default/draft values for the guest segment (7:00-7:30 PM) and sponsor message duration (5 minutes), but none of the decisive facts were triggered. Specifically, the model's failure to hit any content checks indicates that the private information in PF1, PF2, and PF3 is necessary to deviate from these defaults, yet the current check definitions do not sufficiently penalize the model for sticking to the draft state.
